This small plot is mine, and I will do it the way I know from home and from what I have seen nearby. I do not have money to buy fertilizer or sprays, and for a plot this small one bag is too much for me anyway, so I will use farm manure if I get enough and plant the local seed I keep. I will depend on the rains, and my family and I will do the weeding and planting ourselves without bringing in paid workers.
